objects.description: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) has copied payloads to the `ADMIN$` share of remote systems and run net use to connect to network shares.(Citation: Dragos Crashoverride 2018)(Citation: Microsoft Prestige ransomware October 2022)
